reviews.title: A value beast that is rock solid even with 8000 Mhz RAM.
reviews.comment: Built my server with this board, absolutely rock solid. I put in CORSAIR Vengeance DDR5 CUDIMM 48GB (2 x 24GB) DDR5 8000MHz and an Intel Core Ultra 7 Desktop Processor 265K.  It's running 24/7, no hiccups, came back from sleep and hibernate without issue (although I don't use it anymore), and just runs great. Ran Windows as a desktop for a few weeks, then turned it into an LTS Ubuntu server. This thing does everything most people need for a low price.  It's an incredible value. After having so many frustrations with my AMD builds not wanting to come back from standby/hibernate correctly, a build that just works is such a breath of fresh air. And no matter what people say about Intel, this thing just screams at single-threaded tasks, like running Solid Works, etc...  Not everybody is trying to eek out the last 20 FPS for their video games.
reviews.author: Socks

reviews.title: Was highy rated and on sale when I bought, excellent performer.
reviews.comment: Solid performer, 2 weeks into my 265KF build. Still find it fascinating you can update the BIOS without a CPU or graphics card installed. Updated to latest BIOS, installed components, plugged in my Windows 11 USB stick and in under a minute after firing her up, she was installing Windows. After all the updates, installed their software and let it update and install the rest of the needed files and utilities, and I was back up and running, within hours I was able to install everything I had on my previous i5-9600k build, and then I pulled my 2nd M.2 drive and installed with its heatsink into this unit. Like that there is even a space on the back for a 3rd M.2 I chose that Samsung 9100 Pro 2T unit with the fastest speeds I have ever seen on a drive, some G.Skill Flare X5 2x32G @ 6000 and a Thermaltake GF1 850w PSU, then tossed in my old RTX6650XT X2 Mech card, she runs cool and quiet, like intended, great MOBO.
reviews.author: Northwoods Craig

reviews.title: Solid MB so far
reviews.comment: Bought this board for a NAS system I was building. Worked out well with an Intel Ultra 5 processor and 64 gigs of ram. Had some issues with Unraid detecting the onboard fan controllers, but was able to get around it with a community app in their environment.
reviews.author: Matt Davis

reviews.title: Moderna, potente y lista para el futuro
reviews.comment: Monté esta placa en una nueva build con un Intel Core Ultra 7 de 2da generación y todo ha ido perfecto. La instalación fue sencilla, y viene con lo necesario para sacarle provecho desde el primer arranque. El soporte para DDR5 hasta 8600 MT/s OC es una locura —le puse RAM de 6400 MHz y la reconoce sin problema. Algo que me encantó fue que trae Wi-Fi 7 y LAN 5G, lo cual es ideal si no puedes usar cable de red todo el tiempo o quieres aprovechar conexiones más rápidas. También tiene soporte para M.2 Gen5, así que estoy listo para cuando quiera actualizar mi SSD más adelante. En cuanto a estética, el diseño es sobrio pero elegante, muy pro. Y en cuanto a puertos, está bien equipada para ser mATX: suficiente USB, buen VRM para el rango, y hasta PCIe 5.0 x16 para futuras GPU. En resumen: si buscas una placa madre confiable, actualizada y preparada para lo que viene, esta MSI es una gran elección. Estoy muy satisfecho con el rendimiento general y la estabilidad. 100% recomendada.
reviews.author: Bryan Jimer Navia Solórzano

reviews.title: Good Motherboard
